compiled_state.title: [tests/onboarding]: test_design_notes_output greps stale design-notes.md -> fails (SKILL.md migrated to DESIGN.md)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment
* **code_version:** 02a7023eb105a02ab87dd7fd3462f4a14d0625b8
* **File:** tests/skills/test-onboarding-skill.sh (test_design_notes_output, ~lines 389-398)
* **Source:** plugins/dso/skills/onboarding/SKILL.md

### 2. Incident Overview
* **Scenario Type:** Pre-existing failing test (discovered during /dso:sprint on epic dso-uvyl; blocks SKILL.md-touching tasks at the test gate)

#### Expected Behavior
test_design_notes_output should assert that onboarding's SKILL.md references the design-system output artifact that the skill actually writes. The skill migrated design-notes.md -> DESIGN.md (path configurable via design.design_notes_path, default DESIGN.md). The test should grep for DESIGN.md (or the configurable path), and pass.

#### Actual Behavior
The test greps for the literal 'design-notes.md' and expects 'found', but onboarding/SKILL.md (on origin/main: 0 design-notes.md refs, 2 DESIGN.md refs) only references DESIGN.md, so the test reports 'missing' and FAILS (suite: 89 passed, 1 failed). This is pre-existing on origin/main (not introduced by this sprint). Because record-test-status fuzzy-associates any *SKILL.md* change with the broad skill-test set, this stale failure blocks the harvest of unrelated SKILL.md edits (observed blocking story 7913 task 811a in epic dso-uvyl: harvest-worktree.sh exits 2 'test-gate-status is failed').

### 5. Skills and Workflows
* The fuzzy basename association ('SKILL.md' matches all skill tests) is a secondary contributing factor — a change to implementation-plan/SKILL.md should not be gated by onboarding skill tests.

#### Suggested direction (non-binding)
Update test_design_notes_output to grep for 'DESIGN.md' (and/or read design.design_notes_path) instead of 'design-notes.md', and refresh the test comment. Optionally tighten test-source association so a single skill's SKILL.md change does not sweep in every other skill's tests.

comments.body: Fixed: updated test_design_notes_output to assert DESIGN.md (post design-notes->DESIGN.md migration). Suite now 90 passed / 0 failed. Merged to session branch in commit b5002d8364.
